newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Evans Deakin gets part of rail contract.
newsitem.headline: Evans Deakin gets part of rail contract.

text.p: Heavy engineering group Evans Deakin Industries Ltd said on Wednesday it had won A$65 million worth of work after Queensland Railways awarded a contract for the construction of 54 suburban electric railcars.

Evans Deakin said Walkers-Adtranz Pty Limited had been awarded a contract valued at A$135 million by Queensland Railways to build the electric railcars to supplement the current Queensland Railways Brisbane suburban train fleet.
The railcars would be built at Evans Deakin's Walkers plant in Maryborough, Queensland and the project would be managed by Walkers on behalf of Walkers-Adtranz Pty Limited, Evans said.
Adtranz is jointly owned by Swedish-Swiss group Asea Brown Boveri and Daimler-Benz Transportation a unit of Damiler Benz Ag.
